I am an MSc student in **Biostatistics at the University of Zurich**, with a BSc in **Mathematics from Aristotle University of Thessaloniki**.

My academic background combines mathematics, statistical computing, and applications in health and life sciences. My undergraduate project used **Markov chain theory and R** to examine patterns of cancer metastasis using data from 3,827 autopsies.

I have also contributed to an award-winning synthetic biology project with **iGEM Thessaloniki**, and have experience in academic evaluation, data analysis, and international inclusion-focused projects.

## Education

**MSc in Biostatistics** — University of Zurich, 2026–present

**BSc in Mathematics** — Aristotle University of Thessaloniki, 2019–2024

Graduated with a grade of 7.91/10, ranking 13th among 137 graduates.

## Selected highlights

- **iGEM Thessaloniki:** Team member and group leader; silver medal in the 2022 competition.
- **Academic recognition:** Award from the School of Sciences at Aristotle University of Thessaloniki in 2025 for an accessibility video guide.
- **Academic evaluation:** Accreditation panel member for the Hellenic Authority for Higher Education (2021–2024).
- **Conference presentation:** Co-presented work on a mathematical treasure hunt for teaching triangles (2025).
